corridor_notes: This project (西二线、川气东送嘉兴联通工程) is a short point-form interconnection facility, not a long-haul linear transmission pipeline. Per the 2023-08-10 land-use pre-review notice (jiashan.gov.cn), '项目起点为天凝镇洪南村西二线管道，终点为天凝镇洪南村川气东送管道，全长0.8公里' — i.e. both the nominal start (tie-in to West-East Line 2 / 西二线上海支干线嘉兴-甪直联络线) and end (tie-in to 川气东送) are in the same village, 0.8km apart. Per the 2024-01-28 completion/environmental-acceptance notice (zjhby.com), a new interconnection station (嘉善联络站) was built at 浙江省嘉兴市嘉善县天凝镇洪南村, with filtering/metering/flow-regulation facilities and bidirectional flow capability, design pressure 10MPa, design capacity 80×10^8 Nm3/a. Construction: demolished 75m of old West-2-branch pipe, built 288.43m of new DN1016mm inlet/outlet pipe to the station; demolished 46m of old 川气东送 pipe, built 365.73m of new DN1016mm inlet/outlet pipe to the station. Total investment ¥199.13 million. The sasac.gov.cn article (2024-06-17, cited in prior ResearcherNotes) documents system-wide bidirectional throughput context (West-East pipeline system surpassing 500 billion m3 delivered to the Yangtze Delta) but does not name this specific site.
researcher_notes: SPECIAL NOTE per task instructions: GEM's StartLocation=EndLocation was flagged as a likely data defect, but sourced evidence indicates this is NOT actually a defect — this is genuinely a point interconnection facility (a single village/station where two trunk lines are tied together), so start and end are legitimately the same physical location (within the station footprint, tie-in points on opposite sides). What IS flagged as a likely data-quality issue: GEM's LengthMergedKm=20.00 appears inconsistent with sourced figures — the pre-review notice states 0.8km total, and the completion notice describes ~0.65km of newly built pipe (288.43m + 365.73m) plus demolished old-pipe segments (75m + 46m). Recommend flagging the 20km figure for correction in a future update pass (out of scope for this route-creation task, which is endpoints-only).
